content: The Munshaʾāt-i Yazdī comprises two letters from Sharaf al-Dīn to Ibn Turka, a transcription of a few admonitory lines addressed by Ibn Turka to a majlis, and several items about Ibn Turka's children; the Munshaʾāt-i Turka and Munshaʾāt-i Yazdī both testify to the closeness of the two men.
